safety.destructive_operations: No production destructive Graphiti clears/deletes were used. Only disposable restore-test containers were removed.

neo4j_readiness.command: docker exec graphiti-neo4j /var/lib/neo4j/bin/cypher-shell -a bolt://127.0.0.1:7687 ... 'RETURN 1 AS ok;'

curated_ingest_and_query_smoke.ingest_method: POST http://127.0.0.1:8000/episodes from tori-local using curated non-secret operational/provenance episode payload
curated_ingest_and_query_smoke.query_method: POST http://127.0.0.1:8000/search with group_ids limited to the smoke group and max_facts=5
curated_ingest_and_query_smoke.query_expected: Search returns the smoke fact with provenance-bearing timestamp/group context

sample.fact: Graphiti production smoke t_8a57f068 confirms curated operational provenance ingest on tori-local.
sample.name: CONFIRMS

destructive_endpoint_exposure_check.method: From the worker host, attempted direct LAN requests to http://192.168.0.20:8000/healthcheck and POST http://192.168.0.20:8000/clear.
destructive_endpoint_exposure_check.expected: Connection refused because raw Graphiti API is bound to tori loopback only; no raw destructive endpoint is reachable over LAN/agent path.

graphiti_down_degradation_check.method: Local wrapper test against intentionally unavailable base URL http://127.0.0.1:9; production containers were not stopped for this check.
graphiti_down_degradation_check.expected: Wrapper reports graph_unavailable with empty results and caveat directing agents to mem0/session/source-of-truth/live inspection.

actual.caveat: Graphiti is unavailable; use mem0/session/source-of-truth/live inspection instead.

backup_and_restore.approved_method: Offline Neo4j Community dump with bounded service stop; dump created to tori local staging, then copied host-side to NAS to avoid the known stale-NFS bind-mount class.

restore_test.target: Disposable Neo4j container bound only to 127.0.0.1:17474/17687 from restored local staging data; production data path was not mounted or touched.
restore_test.expected: Disposable Neo4j starts and can answer cypher; counts are captured.

notes: The first backup attempt failed before dump creation because the Neo4j container could not write to local staging; staging permissions were corrected and the bounded backup/restore path then passed.

The first restore-test loader attempt was too slow for the foreground command timeout; the same disposable load was rerun with verbose progress and completed successfully. Small-looking Neo4j dumps are apparently still capable of doing the full interpretive dance.
Graphiti API was verified healthy after backup/restore disruption.
residual_risk: Backup is verified as an on-demand dump plus NAS artifact/manifest/restore evidence. A scheduler/job for recurring backups still needs to be wired if not already covered by a later task.
NAS/NFS stale-handle history remains a platform risk; this receipt used host-side NAS copy rather than Docker bind-mounting NAS into the backup/restore containers.
